topic: Clarification of data calibration and core services
summary_markdown: The conversation clarified the source of confusion regarding a 'data changes report.' It was determined that the attached document corresponded to the calibration factor for Denmark. For AFA, the routine procedure involved providing manual counting to calibrate and improve data at high peaks using a multi-parametric Machine Learning model (part of the global Release v 51.2 Core Services). This ML model is used for both peak management and noise reduction. It was explicitly stated that the calibration factor is part of core services, not embedded in the firmware.
decisions: The attached document relates to the calibration factor for Denmark.
action_items: Send the necessary information (implied follow-up after 'just send 🙂').
